description: A small round zen garden tray filled with white sand sits on the table, with a pebble near the top edge and a tiny pagoda-like piece in the center. The left hand steadies the tray at its left rim while the right hand uses a small yellow rake to drag through the sand along the right side, moving downward and slightly inward to smooth and redraw the grooves, then lifting and repositioning for another short pass; the rake is the right-hand object and the tray is the left-hand object.
